meta.lore_check: rules/core_rules.txt: active magic is female-only (Veil Sorceress line, human/elf women); men never activate magic; passive magic via items, potions, runes and relics is allowed for everyone. rules/magic_rules.json: corruption stages, purge methods (breath_ritual, saint_relic). No surgery/medicine skill exists in the repo.

surgery.fallback_note: Surgery target = (INT+DEX)/2 + 5 x Medicine rank + talents; skills['surgery'] overrides.

infection.note: Infection damage is spread with floor 1: it cannot kill on its own (fair rule).

surgery.severed: Mundane surgery cannot reattach a severed part: only stabilise (stops that zone's bleeding) or fit a prosthesis.

skill_model.legacy_override: skills['surgery'] (absolute d100 value) still wins if set
skill_model.note: Medicine is a class/character skill rank (0-5, like the rank style in rules/classes/*.json 'skills'); each rank adds +5 to surgery and first aid.

severed_regrowth.note: Rare and costly: Veil flesh regrows, never quite right (counts toward corruption marks).

relic_or_potion.severed: only a saint relic (rules/magic_rules.json saint_relic, 1 charge) can restore a severed part, no corruption

dwarf_rune_prosthesis.who_crafts: Dwarf master smith only (NPC service); runes are passive magic (core_rules.txt allows passive magic for everyone)
dwarf_rune_prosthesis.penalty: none: works as the lost limb
dwarf_rune_prosthesis.note: Expensive by design. Zone returns to full natural HP + zone_hp_bonus and gets zone_armor; never bleeds again.

elven_restoration.who: Elven alchemists/ritualists as a service or item (potions, rituals, magic stones): passive magic, allowed by core_rules.txt
elven_restoration.result: limb fully regrown to natural HP, no scar
elven_restoration.note: Cannot be applied to a rune prosthesis zone (the stump is sealed by the smith).
